question: What was the role of the prime minister in the planning commission?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Ex-Officio chairman**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The Prime Minister of India served as the **Ex-Officio Chairman** of the Planning Commission during its existence (1950–2014).
 
• The Planning Commission was an institution in the Government of India that formulated India’s Five-Year Plans and various economic policies.
 
• The role of the Ex-Officio Chairman was to provide strategic direction and oversee the formulation and execution of national plans.
 
• The Prime Minister, as the Ex-Officio Chairman, held ultimate authority in decision-making within the Planning Commission.
 
• In 2015, the Planning Commission was replaced by the NITI Aayog, and the Prime Minister became the Ex-Officio Chairman of the NITI Aayog as well.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Planning Commission**

 
 
• Established in 1950 by a resolution of the Government of India under the chairmanship of Jawaharlal Nehru.
 
• The body was tasked with assessing resources and drafting Five-Year Plans to achieve economic and social goals.
 
• It functioned as an advisory body to the Government of India.
 
• It was dissolved in 2014 and replaced by the NITI Aayog (National Institution for Transforming India).
 
 
 
• **NITI Aayog**
 
 
• Formed on January 1, 2015, as the successor to the Planning Commission.
 
• Aims to foster cooperative federalism by involving states in the policy-making process.
 
• Focuses on long-term policy planning and innovation to achieve sustainable development goals.
 
• The Prime Minister serves as the Ex-Officio Chairman of NITI Aayog, with a Governing Council comprising Chief Ministers of states and Union Territories.
 
 
 
• **Five-Year Plans**
 
 
• These were centralized and integrated national economic programs.
 
• India implemented 12 Five-Year Plans between 1951 and 2017.
 
• The first Five-Year Plan focused on agriculture, while later plans emphasized industrialization, infrastructure, and economic liberalization.
 
• After the dissolution of the Planning Commission, Five-Year Plans were replaced by long-term strategies under NITI Aayog.
 
 
 
• **Ex-Officio Position**
 
 
• The term "Ex-Officio" refers to a position held by someone by virtue of another office or role they hold.
 
• For example, the Prime Minister automatically became the Ex-Officio Chairman of the Planning Commission and now of NITI Aayog.
 
• This ensures that the highest executive authority is directly involved in strategic planning and decision-making.
